d: Kale is a dark green vegetable with curly leaves that is very healthy to eat.
A kangaroo is a large Australian animal that jumps on its strong back legs and carries its babies in a pouch.
Karaoke is a fun activity where you sing the words to a popular song over recorded music.
Karate is a Japanese sport where people fight using quick, hard blows with their hands and feet.
Karma is the belief that your good or bad actions will affect what happens to you in the future.
A kayak is a small, narrow boat that you move through the water using a paddle.
A kebab is a dish of pieces of meat and vegetables cooked on a metal stick.
The keel is the long piece of wood or steel along the bottom of a boat that keeps it stable.
If you are keen on something, you are very interested in it and excited to do it.
If you observe something keenly, you pay extremely close and sharp attention to it.
If you keep something, you continue to have it and do not throw it away or give it back.
A keeper is a person whose job is to take care of animals or protect a specific place.
If something is in your keeping, it is in your care and you are responsible for it.
A keg is a small barrel used for storing liquids, especially beer.
Kelp is a type of large, brown seaweed that grows thickly in the ocean.
A kennel is a small wooden shelter made for a dog to sleep in outside.
Kept is the past tense of keep, meaning you continued to hold onto something.
A kernel is the soft, edible part inside the hard shell of a nut or seed.
Ketchup is a thick, cold, red sauce made from tomatoes that you put on food.
A kettle is a metal or plastic pot used for boiling water.
A kettlebell is a heavy metal ball with a handle, used for weightlifting and exercise.
A key is a small piece of shaped metal used for unlocking a door or starting a car.
If a person or detail is key, they are extremely important to achieving a goal.
A keyboard is the set of buttons with letters and numbers that you press to type on a computer.
A keyhole is the small hole in a door lock where you insert the key.
A keynote is the most important speech given at the beginning of a large conference.
A keypad is a small set of buttons with numbers on them, used to open a gate or use a phone.
A keyword is a specific word that you type into a search engine to find information.
Khaki is a light yellowish-brown cloth often used to make military uniforms or casual pants.
If you kick something, you hit it forcefully with your foot.
A kick is a forceful blow made with your foot.
A kid is an informal and common word for a child or young person.
If you kid someone, you playfully say something that is not true as a joke.
If someone kidnaps a person, they take them away illegally by force and demand money.
A kidnapper is a criminal who steals people and hides them to get ransom money.
Kidnapping is the serious crime of forcing someone to go with you against their will.
Your kidneys are the two organs in your lower back that clean waste from your blood.
If someone kills a person or animal, they cause them to die.
A killer is a person or an animal that ends the life of another.
A killing is the violent act of intentionally causing someone to die.
A kiln is a special, very hot oven used for baking clay into hard pottery.
A kilo is a measurement of weight equal to one thousand grams.
A kilogram is the metric unit of weight equal to exactly one thousand grams.
A kilometer is a measurement of distance equal to one thousand meters.
A kilt is a traditional Scottish skirt made of thick wool with a square pattern.
A kimono is a traditional Japanese piece of clothing shaped like a long coat.
Your kin are all the people who are closely related to you in your family.
If someone is kind, they are very caring, helpful, and friendly to others.
A kind is a specific type or category of a person, animal, or object.
Kindergarten is a school for very young children, usually between four and six years old.
If you kindle a fire, you start it burning by lighting small pieces of wood.
If you treat someone kindly, you act in a gentle, warm, and helpful way toward them.
Kindness is the gentle and generous quality of wanting to help other people.
If you have a kindred spirit, you have similar beliefs and feelings to another person.
Kinetic energy is the energy that an object has because it is physically moving.
A king is the male ruler of a country who inherited the position from his family.
A kingdom is a country that is ruled by a king or a queen.
A kink is a sharp twist or bend in a rope, wire, or pipe that stops it from flowing properly.
A kiosk is a small booth in a street or mall where you can buy snacks and magazines.
If you kiss someone, you touch them with your lips to show love or affection.
A kiss is the act of pressing your lips against someone else as a greeting or sign of love.
A kit is a set of tools or parts that you use to build or repair something.
A kitchen is the room in a house where you prepare and cook meals.
A kite is a light frame covered in cloth that you fly in the sky on a windy day.
A kitten is a very young, baby cat.
Kitty is a cute, affectionate word used by children to describe a cat.
A kiwi is a small, brown fruit with hairy skin and bright green flesh inside.
If you have a knack for something, you have a natural skill and ability to do it well.
A knapsack is a canvas bag carried on the back, mostly used by hikers and soldiers.
When you knead dough, you press and squeeze it with your hands to prepare it for baking bread.
Your knee is the joint in the middle of your leg that bends when you walk.
Your kneecap is the hard bone at the front of your knee that protects the joint.
When you kneel, you bend your legs so that your knees are resting on the floor.
Knelt is the past tense of kneel, meaning you rested your body weight on your knees.
Knew is the past tense of know, meaning you already had the information in your mind.
Knickers is a British word for women's or girls' underwear.
A knife is a sharp metal tool with a handle used for cutting food.
If someone knifes a person, they violently attack and stab them with a knife.
A knight was a soldier in the past who wore heavy metal armor and rode a horse.
When you knit, you make clothing like sweaters by looping yarn together with long needles.
Knitting is the activity of making warm clothes out of wool using special needles.
Knives is the plural word for knife, meaning more than one sharp cutting tool.
A knob is a round handle on a door or a round dial on a machine.
If you knock on a door, you hit it hard with your knuckles to make a sound.
A knock is the sharp, loud sound made when someone hits a door.
A knocker is a heavy piece of metal attached to a front door that you hit against it.
A knot is a secure fastening made by tying pieces of rope or string together.
If you knot a tie or string, you tie it tightly so it cannot come loose.
If you know something, you have the facts and truth about it stored in your mind.
A knowing look is one that shows you understand a secret that nobody else gets.
If you do something knowingly, you do it on purpose, fully aware of what you are doing.
Knowledge is all the facts, information, and skills you have learned through experience.
If you are knowledgeable, you are highly intelligent and know a lot about many subjects.
If something is known, people are generally aware of it and recognize it.
Your knuckles are the hard, bony joints in your fingers that bend.
A koala is an Australian animal with thick grey fur that lives in eucalyptus trees.
Kosher food is prepared correctly according to strict Jewish religious laws.
Krypton is a colorless gas used in some brightly colored fluorescent lights.
Kudos is the public praise and respect you get for achieving something spectacular.
Kung-fu is a traditional Chinese martial art focused on self-defense using bare hands.
